The '''RES-Q Airspeeder''' was a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. Designed for medical relief work, the RES-Q had a sleek, oval body with a black [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] viewport. RES-Qs were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and planetary governments. [[Hospital ship/Legends|Medical frigates]] usually carried several RES-Qs.<ref name="LE" />
